title: Miss English blog and grammar musical

blocks.x: Oh okay. On your website there’s sort of a blog about Miss English and her Pet Peeves.

Well I haven’t updated it in a long time because I feel as if maybe it is dated. I know so many people now who are upset at apostrophes being used to pluralize. Somebody posted about it on FaceBook just the other day. I forget what kind of a store it was but let’s say it was Waymans and then it said, you know, couch’s, chair’s, table’s — each with an apostrophe. And they didn’t use an apostrophe for the possessive of the actual name of the place. And I chimed in and I said, “Yeah, you know in L.A. there’s Ralphs Grocery © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

Store and I complained internally about it for many years, not having an apostrophe. And then I found out that the founder’s name was something like Edward Ralphs. So you never know. Yeah, Miss English, there are just — I don’t know there are so many people who are aware of that. But I have a couple of musicals that I have worked on with Nan Schwartz, the wonderful composer in L.A. and one of them is called “The Grammarians.” It’s based on a novel by Cathleen Schine about two identical twins who are obsessed with grammar. So I hope that we can finish that sometime because I really like writing songs about grammar.
